name: Booster Pump 104
description: Primary pressure-boosting pump serving the north process loop. Inspect seals, vibration, guard condition and operating temperature.

name: Air Handler 203
description: Variable-air-volume handling unit. Belt wear was noted on the previous inspection; verify tension, filter condition and condensate drainage.

name: Compressor 012
description: Main shop air compressor. Check oil level, discharge temperature, vibration and audible leaks.

name: Cooling Tower 07
description: Open-circuit cooling tower supporting process cooling. Previous inspection found abnormal fan vibration and intermittent basin-level alarm. Verify fan assembly, guards, water level, drift eliminators and visible corrosion. This intentionally long description is used to validate long-content behavior on narrow and wide layouts.

name: Panel LP-44
description: Lighting and receptacle distribution panel. Inspect enclosure, labeling, clearance and signs of heat damage.

name: Conveyor 18
description: Packaging transfer conveyor. Check belt tracking, guards, emergency stop access and drive noise.

name: Exhaust Fan 305
description: General exhaust fan. Inspect vibration, belt condition, weather seal and guard fasteners.

name: Boiler 02
description: Secondary hot-water boiler. Inspect condensate, venting, pressure and visible fault indicators.

name: Motor 219
description: Drive motor for process mixer. Check vibration, temperature, coupling guard and mounting hardware.

name: Transfer Pump 220
description: Chemical transfer pump. Inspect hoses, fittings, seal area and containment tray.

name: Dock Door 11
description: Powered overhead door. Inspect photo-eyes, track, controls, weather seal and emergency release.

name: Emergency Fan 90
description: Emergency smoke exhaust equipment. Inspect controls, labeling, access and visible mechanical condition.
